canonicalBaseline.note: Canonical is still incomplete nominatively; this run does not invent aliases or change current-party arithmetic.

investigations.tariffModel: Current first-party Magis pages confirm Pay-per-Use exists but explicitly state that the cost is calculated from the tariff shown in the app at the time of use; no public current uniform Pay-per-Use AC/DC amount was found. Subscription prices are deterministic but eligibility/subscription-dependent and must not be promoted as ad-hoc/direct walk-up prices.

fees.occupation: 0.12 EUR/min according to current Magis terms: AC up to 22 kW 07:00-23:00; DC up to 50 kW and HPC up to 350 kW 24h, subject to the release/grace condition defined in terms

investigations.tariffChannel: Magis E-mobility app; Pay-per-Use distinct from subscriptions; roaming eMSP excluded
positiveEvidence: First-party FAQ says Pay-per-Use price is the tariff indicated in the app at the moment of use.
First-party subscription page publishes current AC and DC discounted subscription tariffs.
First-party terms publish an occupation penalty of 0.12 EUR/min with AC/DC/HPC time applicability.
negativePaths: Do not infer current Pay-per-Use from subscription prices.
Do not use V-Reti public-charging supply/distribution tariff tables as retail charging prices.
Do not use third-party Enel/eMSP roaming prices as direct CPO prices.
investigations.blockingCondition: Extract current Magis app station/connector Pay-per-Use payload or another first-party surface proving a uniform current direct tariff and its exact scope; otherwise map EVSE/connector to app-displayed price station by station.

investigations.tariffModel: Fresh July 2026 secondary evidence reports Uattzy class-wide prices: app/card Quick 0.57 EUR/kWh, Fast/Ultra Fast 0.67; occasional POS Quick 0.61, Fast/Ultra Fast 0.72. Current first-party Uattzy site confirms Uattzy defines tariffs for at least its co-investment infrastructure and operates its own app/platform, but the exact amounts and the equivalence of all IT*ESH EVSE to that tariff scope are not first-party proven.
positiveEvidence: Uattzy first-party site confirms own app, proprietary management platform and tariff-setting role for co-investment sites.
Recent July 2026 industry publication reports explicit Quick/Fast/Ultra Fast prices differentiated by app/card versus occasional POS.
negativePaths: Do not promote secondary-source tariff amounts to rankable production without first-party payload/current app proof.
Do not assume every IT*ESH EVSE belongs to the Uattzy tariff-setting scope; host-owned/sold infrastructure may differ.
investigations.blockingCondition: Obtain first-party current Uattzy app/API/POS tariff payload and prove deterministic IT*ESH EVSE scope/classes; then apply only to the proven subset.

coherence.priorityCorrection: ASS class-wide -> station-level for direct/ad-hoc Pay-per-Use until app payload proves uniformity
